xaver.name: Storm Xaver
xaver.description: Extratropical cyclone that struck northwestern Europe on 5–6 December 2013, bringing record-breaking wind gusts, coastal flooding, and widespread infrastructure damage across the British Isles, Denmark, and northern Germany.

kyrill.name: Storm Kyrill
kyrill.description: Powerful extratropical cyclone that swept across Europe on 18–19 January 2007, causing hurricane-force winds, widespread forest damage, and fatalities from the British Isles to Poland and the Czech Republic.

custom-template.name: Custom Simulation
custom-template.description: Template for a user-defined simulation case. Copy this entry, replace the period dates and domain parameters, and supply an id and name that describe your event.
